source_note: Paper 0D evaluation conditions — pulled verbatim (T0, p, Z, dt, t_end). Mixture via Z, not phi.

policy.note: Decision every num_steps chemistry windows at the condition dt. C1: every 20 x 1e-5 s (do NOT sub-cycle at 1e-6).

feature_dt_semantics.temporal: Delta log10 (T and Ykey) between consecutive τ_dec decision snapshots — NOT divided by Delta t; NOT per micro-window (E16.5)
feature_dt_semantics.clock: τ_dec = num_steps × dt_ref (manifest dt_ref / rl.dtRef); chemistry-time accumulator, not CFD micro-window count
feature_dt_semantics.c1_flag: SAFE at dt=1e-5: set rl.dtRef=1e-5 so τ_dec=2e-4; no 1e-6 normalization assumed in gradient stencils

qss_internal.note: Matches handoff solver.qss_dtmax even when outer window dt=1e-5 (C1)

conditions.label: LowT_VeryHighP
conditions.note: 60 atm family — pre-conform QSS stall watch; note qssOnly wall time

gates.of_rl_gate_note: Two-part: |tau(OF-rl)-tau(Py-rl)|/tau(Py-rl)<=5% OR |err(OF-rl vs OF-cvode)| <= |err(OF-qssOnly vs OF-cvode)| + 3 pts; plus |Delta T_final|<=50 K vs OF-cvodeOnly. Rationale: published AdaptiveRL is itself ~+15% at C3; matching the published instrument is the validation claim.
gates.of_qss_envelope_note: Conform-family: |Delta tau|<=15% vs Py-QSS. Delta Teq sign criterion only where |Delta Teq|>=25 K in both frameworks; otherwise magnitude family only.
retired_gates: Hard |Delta tau_rl vs OF-cvode|<=5% alone — retired: published AdaptiveRL exceeds that vs CVODE at some paper conditions
Unconditional QSS late-sign — retired: apply only when |Delta Teq|>=25 K both sides
